order_note: After SQL 90 (required: the file refuses with 55000 sql101_prerequisite_missing without SQL 90's aws_invite_create_user_identity and helpers; it replaces SQL 90's function, so do not re-run SQL 90 afterwards). Production has profiles_id_identity_fkey (aws/rls/sql/25_fk_retarget.sql), so under SQL 90 alone every invite of a brand-new email fails with 23503: apply SQL 101 right after SQL 90 and before tenant-admin.mjs, which calls the function on invite. The plan's sql_before holds tenant-admin.mjs on SQL 90 only, so the SQL 101 order is the operator's gate: confirm SQL 101 is applied before the tenant-admin.mjs production overlay and record it in the change that sets execute true. Independent of SQL 91-100. No Lambda change of its own.
